final_message:
I parsed the log file workspace/worker.log by reading it line by line and identifying log entry start lines using a regex. For each entry, I extracted the timestamp, service, level, and message. I converted the timestamp to UTC in the required format. I collected any extra indented lines and then checked for repeat lines indicating how many times the message repeated. I included only entries with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case insensitive), uppercased the level, and extracted the message after the last " | " separator on the first line. I summed repeat counts and aggregated counts by service. The results were written to workspace/errors.json in the specified JSON structure.

The output file workspace/errors.json is ready and follows the Acme log-triage conventions.
